method.ar1_adjustment: Effective sample size n_eff = n (1 - r1) / (1 + r1) from the lag-1 autocorrelation r1 of the OLS residuals (Santer et al. 2000), t distribution with n_eff - 2 df
method.hac: Newey-West heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent standard error, Bartlett kernel, lags = floor(4 (n/100)^(2/9)), small-sample factor n/(n-2), t distribution
method.loess: Classic LOESS (tricube, local linear, no robustness iterations), span 30 years, statsmodels lowess
method.loess_band: Pointwise 2.5-97.5 percentile band of 500 moving-block (10 year) residual bootstrap refits; reflects smoother variability under stationary noise, not measurement uncertainty
method.naive: OLS slope CI assuming independent residuals (too narrow for temperature series)
